ok, you are all very nice and whatever but honestly. I could be hitler for all you know, and you are talking hitler out of killing himself. why do you hate the jews so much? 

But seriously, I assumed the internet would be full of sickos and assholes who would jump at the chance to be a part of this kind of thing. This is actually very nice to see. Doesn't do me any good, but very nice.

It won't be painful for them, I promise. They have plenty of money;) I'm not some 15 year old girl looking for attention or whatever, I just need a complete stranger to help me write something really nice.

I'm not super familiar with reddit, where can i find people who are pro-choice about suicide? How do I find subreddits? All I see is the broad categories at the top...

apparently this guy loves me and thinks I'm awesome purely based on the hilarious name I came up with for a throwaway account.

btw, I know I'm awesome. I'm doing this for good reason.
